summary: Implementation plan for integrating Gemini AI expressive Gujarati speech with emotional intonation, automatic expansion of titles and abbreviations (e.g. converting 'ડો બાબાસાહેબ' to 'ડૉક્ટર બાબાસાહેબ'), and fixing the app version display so preview accurately reflects v1.0.60 instead of v1.0.58.
